added.title: AI Product Senior Director
added.description:
THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

This is a reimagined product management leadership role for the agentic era, with direct influence over the way we build consumer-facing and enterprise AI.

You will not just measure customer delight, write specs, and triage tickets. You will also build alongside our engineers with AI as your primary force multiplier. You will prototype with Claude Code, Cursor, and Lovable; design and operate the evaluation harnesses that decide what ships; and treat your own PM workflow as a system to instrument, automate, and continuously improve. Our AI portfolio at FanDuel includes consumer-facing chat experiences, agentic marketing workflows and automation, AI-powered product and software development, and more.

As a senior director-level player-coach, you will own one high-leverage agentic product surface end-to-end in collaboration with product managers and designs in tech and commercial, while also mentoring and raising the bar for how Product Management is practiced at FanDuel. You will lead a team of AI PMs that interface directly with business stakeholders, codify patterns for how product management is done in the AI era, and shape the discipline of product management more widely. If your reflex when you see a problem is to open a terminal and an agent harness before you open a Google Doc, this role is for you.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

Mentor and coach AI PMs across the AI and wider product org through pairing, design reviews, written critique, prototype tear-downs, and a shared pattern library you help author. You will supervise multiple AI product managers in the AI Engineering Organization, while also raising the bar for FanDuel’s wider product management practice.

Own end-to-end for one or more workstreams (growth & marketing, customer experience, product innovation, enterprise acceleration), including strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and outcomes. You will build working prototypes with Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, and modern agent frameworks. And you will design and operate evaluation systems — golden sets, offline evals, online experiments, drift and regression detection, human-rater pipelines — for every surface you own. Define what "good" means in numbers before you ship.

Partner daily with Business partners, FDEs, AI SWE pods, AI Platform, Trust & Safety, Responsible AI, and Legal. Translate ambiguous business problems into agent-shaped solutions that respect our regulatory and RG posture. Set the bar for AI-native PM craft across the function: write and maintain CLAUDE.md files, build MCP-aware tooling for the PM team, share patterns in writing, and pair with other PMs on hard problems.

THE STATS

What we're looking for in our next teammate

10-12+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years shipping AI and/or LLM-powered products in production.
Demonstrated fluency building with modern AI development tools. You can point to prototypes, agents, evals, MCP servers, or PRs you have personally built — not just shipped through others.
Strong technical depth: comfortable reading and writing code, comfortable in system design conversations, comfortable in an eval notebook. You don't need to be a senior engineer, but engineers should want to pair with you.
Working understanding of agentic infrastructure: MCP, orchestration patterns, tool use, retrieval, context engineering, prompt evaluation, and runtime observability.
Track record operating as a player-coach — elevating peers and shaping practice without org-chart authority.
Demonstrated experience designing or operating evaluation systems for ML or LLM products at meaningful scale.
Sharp written communicator with a strong bias toward written artifacts — one-pagers, decision memos, RFCs, postmortems.

About Fanduel

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

About The Team

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

The AI Platforms & Experiences (APEX) team is FanDuel's AI function for cutting edge artificial intelligence. We design, ship, and operate the AI capabilities that power our marketing funnel, product experiences, internal tooling, and emerging agentic platform. The org is structured around five pillars: Forward Deployed Engineers embedded in business units, AI Software Engineering pods, an AI Platform team, AI Product Managers, and AI strategy & transformation.

We are not a research lab, and we are not the Data org. We are builders, shipping production AI systems against real customer and operator problems, with eval-first rigor, responsible-AI guardrails, and a strong bias toward small, fast, instrumented teams.

This role is different, because:

You are not joining a mature playbook. This role exists to define what AI-native PM looks like at FanDuel and to ship the surfaces other PMs will build on.
You will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with the FDEs, SWEs, and Platform engineers who build the agentic stack you'll own product for.
You will have air cover from a CTO-sponsored AI Engineering function, with direct line of sight into the company's AI roadmap and architectural decisions.
You will be measured on systems and impact, not pixels. Output is judged in evals, experiments, and shipped product.

Player Benefits

We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards
. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included.

FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com.

added.description:
We at Pelagic are excited to share an opening at one of our long-time partners, Equip Foods!

WHY EQUIP FOODS

We are a countermovement to over complicated health trends. Creators of the beef protein category - a clinically-proven, gut-friendly alternative to whey and plant-based protein. Nutrient-dense, minimally-processed, real-food nutrition. We believe humans should eat real food and when you do supplement, it shouldn't be with weird isolated ingredients - it should be with more real food.

We exist to set a new standard in an industry that is incredibly shady; fancy packaging with ineffective doses, lack of transparency, under-dosed products relative to label claims. Without regulation, it is up to us, the brands, to set the standard. Simple, real-food supplements with 100% transparency on label claims, third-party tested for hundreds of toxins that have found their way into our food supply.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on, high-output Director of Product Development to own our product roadmap, R&D, and commercialization from concept through launch. This is not a traditional product management role, and we're not looking for someone who mainly coordinates outside R&D resources. We need a leader with deep, direct experience developing and commercializing protein powders and nutrition bars.

You should be comfortable taking a product from brief to bench, through pilot and scale-up, and into successful commercial production. You'll set product development strategy, manage external technical and manufacturing partners, identify risks early, and get into the details when something needs to get unstuck.

This role works closely with Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, Marketing, Growth, Retail, and co-manufacturers. It requires someone who can think strategically and is equally comfortable working through formulations, attending plant trials, calling ingredient suppliers, tasting iteration 17, or traveling onsite when that is the fastest way to solve a problem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Product Development and R&D

Pipeline and Portfolio Strategy

Commercialization and Launch Execution

Co-Manufacturer and Partner Leadership

Please review the full JD for a much more detailed description of your role, responsibilities, and specific expectations for each of the areas above - linked here: https://equipfoods.notion.site/Director-of-Product-Equip-Foods-3e412b868115806d9c77febfde76654d

HOW YOU OPERATE

More than anything, we're looking for someone with ownership, judgment, and resourcefulness. You'll do well here if:
Your first reaction when something goes wrong is, "I've got it." You start solving the problem instead of only reporting it
You work autonomously, set clear goals, and hold yourself accountable for the result
You identify risks early, communicate them clearly, and bring a recommendation with the problem
You keep digging until you understand the root cause and know enough technically to challenge food scientists and manufacturing partners when something does not add up
You are organized, data driven, and comfortable making decisions without perfect information
You move quickly without getting sloppy and can shift between high-level strategy and tactical execution
You are scrappy and willing to make the call, find the expert, chase the sample, run another trial, or get on a plane when needed
You communicate clearly in a distributed environment and are comfortable working asynchronously in writing
You have low ego, care deeply about health, and will do what the situation requires to get the right outcome
When you say you own something, people trust that it is handled

REQUIREMENTS

At least five years of hands-on CPG food product development experience, ideally in nutrition, supplements, functional foods, or beverages, with direct ownership of commercialization
Deep, direct experience developing and commercializing both protein or nutrition powders and protein or nutrition bars
A track record of personally leading multiple products from formulation through commercial-scale production
Strong technical understanding of protein systems, flavor systems, sweeteners, fats, binders, stabilizers, moisture management, texture, solubility, stability, shelf life, processing conditions, and ingredient interactions across product formats
Extensive experience working directly with co-manufacturers, navigating rapid iteration, and troubleshooting issues at commercial scale
A strong network in the powder and bar ecosystem, including manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, flavor houses, food scientists, and other technical resources
Experience leading bench work, plant trials, scale-ups, and first commercial productions
Working knowledge of food safety, quality assurance, specifications, labeling, claims, testing, and regulatory requirements
Strong project management and cross-functional coordination skills, including the ability to manage multiple complex programs and priorities
Willingness and enthusiasm to travel regularly for R&D trials, manufacturing runs, supplier visits, and hands-on problem solving
Proven ability to thrive in a fast-growing, lean, remote team and move between strategy and execution

NICE-TO-HAVES

Degree in Food Science, Food Engineering, Nutrition, Chemistry, or a related field
Experience with beef, collagen, dairy, or other animal-protein systems
Experience developing products with short, clean ingredient decks, natural flavor systems, and naturally derived sweeteners
Experience launching products into national retail, including retailers such as Whole Foods, Sprouts, and Erewhon
Experience with shelf-life validation, analytical and third-party testing, sensory programs, quality assurance, and product certifications
Experience qualifying and onboarding new co-manufacturing and ingredient partners

YOU WILL PROBABLY HATE THIS ROLE IF

Most of your product experience has been project management rather than hands-on development and commercialization
You do not have meaningful experience developing both protein powders and nutrition bars
You would rather manage consultants and co-manufacturers than get directly involved in technical problem solving
You expect a large team, a specialized resource for every problem, or constant direction before you can move
You prefer predictable, repeatable work, limited travel, or frequent calls to talk through decisions
You are uncomfortable pushing or challenging manufacturers, suppliers, and technical experts
Your first instinct when something goes wrong is to schedule a meeting instead of starting to solve it
You think the work is done once the formula is approved

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

Problems are identified earlier and solved faster. Products improve. Launches become more predictable. Equip's network of technical and manufacturing partners gets stronger. The rest of the company can move faster because product development is in good hands

OTHER DETAILS

Fully remote and location independent
High growth potential and opportunity
High performance will result in high compensation

BENEFITS

We are extremely intentional about how we support you as an individual. Our benefits contribute to your education, well-being, health, and self-improvement so you can be your best self!
Top-of-the-line health care, vision, and dental plans
$200 per month for local farmers market purchases and food
$200 per month for a gym membership or personal fitness
A free Kindle and unlimited free books
$1,000 per year for continued learning and training programs
$200 per month for emotional and mental wellness
No fixed work schedule or monitoring of hours. You create your own working environment
Flexible work arrangements and unlimited time off
Free company products

College Board – OCEP/Digital Product

Location:
This is a remote role, aligned to core EST hours
. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type
: This is a full-time position

About The Team

The Digital Product division is driving the evolution of College Board’s digital assessment experience, providing opportunities that shape futures and open doors. As AI reshapes education, we are preparing students for the future by ensuring our digital assessments remain secure, meaningful, and reflective of the knowledge and skills needed to thrive in an AI-enabled world.

The Digital Product Operations team exists to bring clarity, structure, and measurable outcomes to how College Board’s Digital Product organization plans, delivers, and improves. We are a small, high-performing team that owns the operational systems, practices, and cross-functional coordination that enable 15+ product teams to deliver meaningful digital assessment experiences to millions of students and educators every year. We partner closely with Product, Technology, Design, and go-to-market functions, and we hold ourselves to the same bar we help others reach: rigorous, data-informed, and always improving.

Together, we are transforming College Board’s trusted assessment platform into a next generation digital assessment experience that is secure, user-centered, and built to evolve with the future of learning and assessment.

About The Opportunity

As Director, Delivery & Release Management, Digital Product Operations, you thrive in complex, multi-team environments, seeing dependencies before they become blockers and simplifying without losing fidelity. You are a change agent with the ability to lead through influence rather than authority. You're comfortable building something new in a thoughtful, incremental way rather than mandating change overnight.

In this role, you are the operational engine behind how Digital Product ships, the connective tissue between product development and go-to-market readiness. You own the systems, processes, and coordination that ensure new features and platform releases are planned with precision, tested with rigor, and launched with confidence, so the releases that reach millions of students and educators each year go out right. You build the process, then coach product, technology, and go-to-market teams through adopting it, bringing visibility, predictability, and accountability to how work moves from backlog to live. You earn trust through consistency and results, not a reporting line, with a drive to relentlessly improve the systems you own.

In This Role, You Will

Release Management & Launch Readiness (35%)

Act as a change agent for how Digital Product ships — convene Product, Technology, GTM teams, and leadership stakeholders to understand and align on their expectations before designing the release process; synthesize that input into a defined, documented release process that reflects the full organization’s needs and serves as the standard for how Digital Product ships
Own and drive adoption of the release management process across all teams — coaching Product, Technology, and GTM teams through the process
Own end-to-end release management for Digital Product — from feature intake through post-launch review — across SAT Suite, AP, CLEP, ACCUPLACER, and Bluebook platform releases
Define and continuously improve release management standards, including how product information, release notes, and updates are communicated internally and externally
Develop and maintain the integrated release calendar, surfacing cross-team dependencies, milestone risks, and capacity constraints to leadership
Partner with Product, Technology, and GTM teams to ensure every release is preceded by accurate documentation, confirmed artifact delivery, and resolution of operational blockers — coordinating with Learning, Enablement & Readiness on people-side preparation
Partner with the Director, ProdOps Intelligence & Strategy to use release and launch metrics to identify coaching opportunities and process improvement areas — continuously refining the release management process based on data and stakeholder feedback until adoption is consistent and self-sustaining

Platform User Acceptance Testing (35%)

Own and manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Digital Product platform — the cross-platform validation that confirms the platform works as expected from a real user and stakeholder perspective before every major release
Act as a change agent for UAT practices across Digital Product — assess current UAT maturity across product teams, set clear UAT standards and goals in partnership with Product and Technology leaders, and motivate teams to develop the discipline of rigorous pre-launch validation; own the adoption of UAT processes across Digital Product, coaching teams through the process and iterating based on feedback
Plan and execute UAT in partnership with Product Leaders, Managers, Owners, and Technology, including issue triage and final sign-off before launch
Design and scale UAT processes that are repeatable, efficient, and appropriately rigorous as our portfolio of product releases grows
Track and communicate UAT status, open issues, and resolution timelines to product and leadership stakeholders
Serve as the quality gate between development and launch, ensuring releases meet user, performance, and accessibility standards before going live
Partner with engineering, technical testing, and individual product teams to ensure UAT complements — rather than duplicates — their testing efforts, and clarify where each type of testing begins and ends

Planning Coordination & Operational Visibility (30%)

Participate in quarterly planning cycles to surface and resolve cross-team dependencies specifically related to release sequencing, UAT scheduling, and delivery timelines — ensuring the release calendar reflects the full picture of what is shipping and when across all product domains
Own and maintain delivery-specific artifacts in Digital Product tools — including the integrated release calendar, UAT schedules, and release readiness trackers — ensuring they are current, accurate, and trusted as the source of truth for what is shipping and when
Provide leadership with clear, narrative-synthesized visibility into delivery progress, release health, and key risks on a regular cadence
Develop recommendations on process improvements with clear rationale and tradeoffs — own the implementation of changes, drive adoption across teams, and evaluate outcomes to confirm the improvement delivered the expected result
Own the annual capitalized software reporting process in partnership with Finance — coordinating with Product and Technology leads to compile new functionality descriptions, IT development timelines, and release dates across all Digital Product platforms (including BAWP) required for the FY capitalized software memo

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

5+ years of experience in product operations or product management within a digital product or SaaS environment, with a strong focus on delivery and release management
Experience leading or contributing to change management efforts, helping teams adopt new ways of working
Comfort operating with ambiguity, defining tooling and evolving processes for a team still establishing its ways of working
Demonstrated experience owning release management and UAT processes across multiple concurrent product teams
Deep familiarity with Agile delivery practices and product management tooling with a track record of improving how teams use them
Ability to lead through influence rather than authority, earning trust and buy-in from teams who don't report to you
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; equally comfortable in planning sessions and stakeholder readiness reviews with Product, Technology, Design, and go-to-market leads
Exceptional organizational and communication skills; you create clarity for others, not just yourself
A bias toward simplicity; you design processes people actually follow
The ability to travel 5-7 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All Roles At College Board Require

A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input
A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking
A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

About Our Process

Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

The Senior Product Manager will independently own complex, ambiguous product areas end to end—from identifying and validating the right problems to setting product direction, guiding delivery, driving adoption, and iterating based on evidence.

You will work directly with global health authorities, life sciences sponsors, regulatory operations professionals, internal subject matter experts, and Technology teams to uncover meaningful problems and develop scalable solutions. Product Strategy and Ownership

Independently own one or more strategic product areas, translating broad company goals into a clear product direction, and execution plan.
Develop a deep understanding of regulatory engagements, user workflows, market dynamics, and the technical and compliance constraints that shape the Accumulus Platform.
Frame ambiguous opportunities, evaluate alternatives, make principled prioritization decisions, and provide clear recommendations about what to build, what not to build, and why.

Articulate the value and future direction of the platform to internal leaders, customers, partners, and other market-facing audiences.

Discovery and Validation

Lead discovery directly with regulator, and sponsor users to uncover underlying needs, behaviors, constraints, and opportunities rather than relying on stated requirements alone.
Design and execute research plans, interviews, workflow studies, experiments, and concept tests that reduce uncertainty and test the most important product hypotheses.

Combine qualitative insight, product data, market evidence, and technical input to make well-reasoned product decisions before and after launch.

Identify where AI can create meaningful user and business value, and distinguish those opportunities from use cases where AI would add unnecessary complexity or risk.

About Health Payment Systems, Inc. (HPS/PayMedix)

Health Payment Systems, Inc. (HPS/PayMedix), is redefining how people access and pay for healthcare. We bring together provider networks, payments and financing, and industry partners to remove financial barriers and simplify the healthcare experience for everyone involved.

Our team is solving one of the biggest challenges in healthcare: the flow of money and information between providers and consumers. The work we do improves access, reduces financial stress, and is reshaping how healthcare works at its most fundamental level.

Our solutions include:
HPS Network: a high-performing, independent provider network in Wisconsin that helps employers control costs while maintaining strong access to care.
PayMedix: a national healthcare payments platform that pays providers in full, consolidates medical information and billing, and offers members interest-free financing for all in-network costs
TempoPay: a flexible healthcare benefit solution that gives eligible individuals a simple, predictable way to pay for care over time, with zero interest or fees.

Join us in our mission to make the healthcare payments experience simpler, more transparent, and more connected – so people can focus on getting care when they need it, not when they think they can afford it.

About The Role

HPS/PayMedix is undergoing a major transformation of its payments ecosystem. As transaction volume scales rapidly, we are investing ahead of growth to consolidate vendors, streamline ledgering, increase operational efficiency, and further strengthen our enterprise-grade payments infrastructure.

We are hiring a dedicated Payments Product Manager
to drive the execution of this initiative. This role will focus on implementing a cleaner, more scalable, and strategically aligned payments architecture that supports card, ACH, virtual card, and emerging payment rails, while translating a defined modernization strategy into structured execution and measurable outcomes. This will help build the foundation for long-term enterprise value and scalable growth.

This role reports directly to the Chief Product & Innovation Officer and is fully remote.

Primary Responsibilities

Payments Infrastructure Execution: Create a multi-year roadmap that includes platform capabilities. Lead the implementation of a consolidated payments architecture across processors, banks, and ledger systems. Execute across authorization, settlement, batching, reconciliation, funding, payouts, and refunds/recoupments. Drive delivery through partnerships with finance, operations, compliance, engineering and executive leadership.

Ledgering & Reconciliation: Implement upgraded and outsourced ledgering capabilities that improve traceability, reporting accuracy, and auditability while reducing manual reconciliation and integrating claims, payments, and financial reporting.

Payment Rails Expansion & Innovation: Lead execution across RTP, FedNow, ACH, card, and virtual card programs, including routing logic, controls, reconciliation, and multi-rail requirements that improve flexibility, speed, and cost efficiency. Enhance provider, employer, external partner and member experience.

Vendor & Bank Integration Management: Own integration requirements and sequencing across processors, banks, and hybrid infrastructure partners, ensuring clean routing, scalability, flexibility, and support for advanced payout models.

Economics, Reliability & Scale: Improve authorization rates, returned payments, refunds, settlement timing, operational error rates, and cost per transaction while strengthening platform resilience and margin efficiency as volume grows.

Risk & Compliance: Ensure payment workflows meet applicable NACHA, card brand, sponsor bank, audit, and regulatory requirements while partnering with Compliance, Finance, and Operations toidentifyand mitigate risk early.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of Product Management experience in payments or fintech, including ownership of product roadmaps, product requirements, and direct partnership with engineering teams.

Experience in B2B and B2B2C payments environments with complex or intermediated money movement.

Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and lifecycle, including ACH, cards, payment gateways, merchant acquiring, ledgering, reconciliation, settlement, refunds, exceptions, chargebacks, and payment APIs.

Proven ability to build and scale payment capabilities across internal and external partners, including processors, banks, SaaS vendors, and cross-functional business and technology teams.

Key Attributes for Success

Cross-Functional Influence & Communication: Builds alignment across executives, technical teams, business stakeholders, and external partners, translating complex payment concepts into clear decisions and actions.

Systems Thinking & Complexity Management: Understands end-to-end payment flows and how decisions across systems, vendors, ledgering, reconciliation, and operations impact one another.

Ownership & Execution in Ambiguity: Creates structure in complex or unclear environments, makes sound tradeoffs, and drives initiatives from requirements through successful delivery.

The Director, AI Product Manager – AI Product Frameworks

Unlike ‑Product Managers within the Digital Product Management organization, this role treats AI itself as the product

This role centers on strategy, discovery, and value framing, working closely with each Business and Functional area to shape AI direction, identify high‑value opportunities, and expand the art of the possible for how AI can transform their domain. Ensure EJ Labs’ AI platform capabilities are adopted by the AI Product Managers across Knowledge, Models, Skills, and Agents.
